hypothesis: Rotation-augmented PIMPLE-path source pretraining may need matching PIMPLE-path supervision during target LR adaptation; the previous rotation run adapted every target arm with final-only labels.

population.target_support: the existing four LR support trajectories per F5 task
population.target_validation: the existing V1 LR validation plus two fresh V2 LR validation trajectories per F5 task
population.development_hr: the four existing V2 F5 HR query trajectories, opened only after model checkpoints are frozen
population.confirmation_hr: none in this screening stage; any later confirmation must use a fresh, independently generated F6 query set

fixed_source.checkpoint: rotation-augmented selected_pimple_path source checkpoint from rotation_source_lr_diagnostic.json

training.checkpoint_selection: mean 20-step autoregressive relative-L2 over six LR validation trajectories only
training.path_label: earliest complete non-endpoint PIMPLE outer state at each physical step, matching the frozen method dataset selection
training.matched_control: endpoint direction scaled to the selected path correction norm

decision_rule.screening: Freeze all checkpoints before opening F5 HR development data. Continue to new F6 confirmation only if selected_pimple_path target adaptation beats both final_only and matched_endpoint_control by at least 1% in mean F5 HR 20-step rollout relative-L2, with no F5 task worse than either control.
decision_rule.confirmation: A positive F5 screen is not a claim. Confirm once on new F6 HR query ICs that are not present in V1 or V2; compare the same path, final, and matched arms using the identical primary metric.

prohibitions: Do not use any F6 HR query from V1 or V2 to train, select, or tune this follow-up.
Do not change model architecture, optimizer, loss weights, data roles, or the registered screening threshold after training begins.
Do not treat the already reported V2 F6 confirmation result as a tuning signal for this follow-up.
